note: Projects that target climate as a secondary objective are counted at their full value. The OECD's climate tracking excludes general budget support, debt relief, and some costs in donor countries, such as hosting refugees.
title: Share of foreign aid received that is climate-related
subtitle: Committed bilateral [official development assistance (ODA)](#dod:oda) that targets climate change mitigation, adaptation, or both, as a share of the bilateral ODA received that is covered by the OECD's climate tracking.
